name: Oikawa Chisato
source:
Chisato doesn't bother with make-up to avoid risking her life guys who hit on her on her way home from school.
Up until now she has had relationships with countless men.
Chisato used to fight with her parents a lot because of her habit to go out at night too much, but lately they've kind of given up on her.

[Translated from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20001018095504/http://www1.odn.ne.jp/d-xx/lineup/gizen/chara.htm]official website[/url].]
